title: Correct Schrödinger Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the Schrödinger equation for atomic helium as specified in the reference solution.

title: Kinetic Energy Terms
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and include the kinetic energy terms for both electrons in the equation.

title: Potential Energy Terms
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly include the attractive potential terms between the nucleus and the electrons, as well as the repulsive potential between the electrons.

title: Neglecting Nucleus Motion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the assumption of the nucleus being an infinitely heavy point charge and neglecting its motion.

title: Variable Definitions
description: Optional Criteria: The student may define the variables used in the equation, such as R1 and R2.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the potential energy terms of the equation.

title: Missing Terms
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure all necessary terms are included in the equation to avoid missing factors.
